name: memory-tool-refactor
details:
Refactor MCP server from 6 separate tools to single "memory" tool with discriminated union schema.

This addresses the critical design error where the server was exposing 6 tools (memory_view, memory_create, etc.) instead of one unified "memory" tool matching the official Anthropic Memory tool specification.

The refactor uses Zod discriminatedUnion to provide type-safe command dispatch with clear parameter requirements for each command variant.

tasks.name: Schema Refactoring
tasks.details: Create unified schema using Zod discriminatedUnion for all 6 memory commands

sub_tasks.name: Create discriminated union schema
sub_tasks.details: In src/server/mcp-server.ts, create MemoryCommandSchema using z.discriminatedUnion('command', [...]) with all 6 command variants (view, create, str_replace, insert, delete, rename). Each variant should have z.literal('command_name') for the command field and only the relevant parameters for that command.

sub_tasks.name: Export command type
sub_tasks.details: Export TypeScript type from the schema: export type MemoryCommand = z.infer<typeof MemoryCommandSchema>. This provides type safety for the dispatcher and operations.

sub_tasks.name: Keep individual schemas for validation
sub_tasks.details: Keep the existing individual command schemas (ViewCommandSchema, CreateCommandSchema, etc.) as they may be useful for internal validation and testing. These can be private or exported as needed.

tasks.name: MCP Tool Registration
tasks.details: Replace 6 tool registrations with single unified memory tool

sub_tasks.name: Remove old tool registrations
sub_tasks.details: Delete all 6 existing server.registerTool() calls (memory_view, memory_create, memory_str_replace, memory_insert, memory_delete, memory_rename) from createMemoryServer function.

sub_tasks.name: Register single memory tool
sub_tasks.details: Add single server.registerTool('memory', {...}) call with the discriminated union schema as inputSchema. The tool name must be exactly 'memory' to match the spec.

sub_tasks.name: Implement command dispatcher
sub_tasks.details: Create tool handler function that: 1) validates params with MemoryCommandSchema.parse(), 2) uses switch/case on command.command field to dispatch to appropriate operations function, 3) returns MCP tool response with text content.

tasks.name: Test Updates
tasks.details: Update all tests to use new unified memory tool interface

sub_tasks.name: Update memory-operations tests
sub_tasks.details: In test/memory-operations.test.ts, change all tool calls from individual tools (memory_view, memory_create, etc.) to single 'memory' tool with command parameter. E.g., {tool: 'memory', params: {command: 'view', path: '/memories'}}

sub_tasks.name: Verify discriminated union validation
sub_tasks.details: Add tests that verify: 1) invalid command values are rejected, 2) wrong parameters for a command are rejected (e.g., passing file_text to view command), 3) correct parameters for each command work as expected.

sub_tasks.name: Run test suite
sub_tasks.details: Run npm test to verify all tests pass with the new interface. All 59 tests should still pass.

tasks.name: Documentation Updates
tasks.details: Update project documentation to reflect new unified tool interface

sub_tasks.name: Update README.md
sub_tasks.details: Update README.md examples to show single 'memory' tool with command parameter. Update tool usage examples and API documentation.

sub_tasks.name: Update ARCHITECTURE.md
sub_tasks.details: Update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md to explain the discriminated union schema design and how command dispatch works.

sub_tasks.name: Update CLAUDE.md handoff
sub_tasks.details: Update SESSION HANDOFF section in /home/jan/projects/memory-mcp/CLAUDE.md to note the interface change and mark this refactor as complete.

tasks.name: Build and Verify
tasks.details: Compile, test, and verify the refactored implementation works correctly

sub_tasks.name: Run TypeScript compiler
sub_tasks.details: Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation succeeds with the new types and schema.

sub_tasks.name: Run linter
sub_tasks.details: Run npm run lint to check for any code quality issues introduced by the refactor.

sub_tasks.name: Manual smoke test
sub_tasks.details: Optionally test with MCP Inspector or Claude Code to verify the tool works correctly with the new interface. Check that command dispatch works and parameters are validated correctly.
